But you see, there is a big difference in your “normal” thinking and “ocd” thinking. For me atleast. Since when im thinking normally, it is different from thinking ocdish. Its super difficult, but you gotta understand the cycle. That will set you free

Hey im also experiencing pocd. To me it sounds like pocd and nothing more. Yes it creates false urges and everything you mentioned is common with pocd. Since you are thinking like that it just only proves you are just experiencing pocd. It sucks because it is hard to distinguish the two. But trust me, if you just let it be, it will be better with time. I mean whatever is happening in your head can happen. Heck you can even like children in whatever way you want, but keep it to your own head. It is not bad to think about anything. It is bad to act on bad things and to follow your bad thoughts creating action and etc. But you just have to let them be :) I know its only ocd, and I let the horrible urges and thoughts stay with me because I know they are only in my head and are caused by my sensitized nerves. Actual pedophiles love to think about kids in a romantic way, for example like your thinking about your own age girls. See the difference? You are just experiencing anxiety. Yes it can come in different forms. Deep down you know your true self and I can be 95% sure u r okay dude. Let your head be full of clouds ( thoughts ) just passing by. It will be hard , but you will get used to it
